architecture_selection: highest mean final source-validation accuracy over three preselected groups; target labels/results not consulted
source_endpoint: fixed final update count, no per-group test or validation checkpoint selection
target_tuning_policy: equal validation search for every source condition and random initialization, separately for task-free linear, query linear, task-free MLP and fine-tuning, using seed17 and averaging all targets/support budgets; condition-specific selected policies apply to all three seeds; also report the shared random-selected fine-tuning policy
final_eval_policy: new target-test data untouched until source protocol and adaptation settings are fixed; report all groups and seeds; exploratory follow-up to prior pilot
limitations: Only one new source training data world; source seeds are conditional replications, not five independent data worlds.
Same eight source task sets and four targets as before; new training and target inputs, not new mathematical domains.
Single and multi-task source losses have different gradient objectives; per-task exposure, sample schedule, initialization and optimizer are held fixed.
Five seed confidence intervals are descriptive and sensitive to few replications.
Incremental relation prediction is conditional on the eight selected groups, not a causal test of relation structure.

primary_effect.unit: source model seed, five seeds, conditional on one new data world

single_task_question: compare candidate with each of its four single-task encoders under the same adaptation policy; report all four, no selection of a best single model

primary_prediction.seeds: first three specified new seeds per group
primary_prediction.outcome: paired gain over same-seed random model
primary_prediction.weights_fit: average the two old target-pool gains per old group/seed/target; alpha=1; no old initialization dummy features
primary_prediction.uncertainty_unit: task group, descriptive cluster bootstrap over eight specified groups
primary_prediction.heldout_scope: new source-data world and source-model seeds; same eight task sets; not unseen task combinations

protocol_scope: follow-up selected from old outcomes; candidate, seeds, tasks, budgets, policies and prediction analysis frozen before fresh data or retraining
